critical_items.note: Form C XML identifies TradeFunded LLC (DE LLC, incorporated 2026-02-10) and the offering terms. Offering file no. 020-37393 is in the pack's offering table.
The security is LLC 'Units' (membership interests held beneficially via a custodian/nominee). It is not a SAFE or note.

The Subscription Agreement is readable (pages 57-69). Only parts of the Operating Agreement are readable; many pages of the 172-page PDF were not processed, including the Liquidity Event definition, Article V vesting and voting sections.
Price $0.35 per Unit is cited. There is no valuation cap or conversion mechanism, since this is direct equity. The price is stated to be arbitrary, with no pre-Offering valuation ascribed.

Minimum individual purchase is $350; the maximum is $149,999.85. Intermediary fees are paid by the issuer. Any investor-side fees (e.g., custodian) are not confirmed in the readable pages and must be checked on the platform.

Reviewed (not audited) statements as of 2026-04-30 are readable. The Form C XML cash field (0.00) conflicts with the balance sheet cash ($226,885). The June 30 cash figure is unreviewed and the runway claim is unsupported.
Pack shows no closing reported and platform availability unverified (Republic pages not accessible). A future deadline of 2026-12-15 is not proof the offering is open.

missing_information: Pages 1-2, 4-7, 12-19, 22, 28-31, 33-36, 40-46 and many later pages of tradef.pdf were not processed. This leaves business description, competition, team biographies, the CFTC Action section, most risk factors and the Previous Offerings section unseen.
No team biographies or documented execution history for the founders or managers are in the readable pages.
No competitor names or differentiation statements in the readable pages.
No customer, contract, usage or pilot data. Revenue is $0 and the company says it has not commenced principal revenue-generating operations.
The use-of-proceeds table is OCR-garbled, so amounts and percentages by category cannot be cited reliably.
Basis for the 24-36 month runway claim (monthly net loss history, post-April 2026 expense data) and June 30, 2026 cash support. No financial statements after April 30, 2026.
Definition of 'Liquidity Event', vesting provisions and voting provisions in the Operating Agreement (pages not processed).
SAFE terms (cap, discount) and the identity and amounts of the nine Seed Investors.
Explanation of the 'loan agreements' and 'existing credit facilities' references in the Subscription Agreement versus the stated zero debt.
Status of the IRS Form 8832 election and whether the financial statements will be restated.
Platform availability and investor-side fees (e.g., custody fees); the Republic page was not accessible.
Details of the 'TradeFunded Capital LLC' subsidiary (98% owned) financials, trading activity and how funded trader payouts work.

convertible_instruments.note: The statements show $250,000 of proceeds via SAFE conversion. The issuer states zero additional securities are outstanding. SAFE cap and discount terms are not in the readable pages. The intermediary receives additional securities equal to 2% of Securities sold (A6), count not fixed.

valuation_inputs.note: Price is stated to be arbitrary. Issued/outstanding Units (7,500,000) are distinct from authorized (10,000,000) and reserved Units. Values should not be computed from authorized or reserved shares. The intermediary's 2% securities compensation adds to outstanding Units after the Offering.
